diagram-definition.user-facing-description: A small Mermaid ERD for users, documents, and user settings.
diagram-definition.development-scope-and-focus: Describe the initial relational model for an imaginary document app. Focus on table structure, primary keys, and foreign key relationships between users, documents, and settings.

lucid-flyway.description: Created the initial Mermaid ERD with USERS, DOCUMENTS, and SETTINGS tables. Users own documents and have one settings record.
